title: hive dispatch result notice (v1)
description: One JSON file under <state_home>/dispatch_results/, atomic-written by the daemon when a bot-originated, daemon-spawned run exits non-zero, and consumed by the Telegram bot to relay the failure back to the originating chat (ADV-1). Runs the opposite direction of hive-dispatch-request. The bot removes each notice after relaying it. Strict-version-matched — any schema_version != 1 is rejected and the file removed.

result_id.description: Hex id of the notice. Daemon uses SecureRandom.hex(8).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp the notice was written.

chat_id.description: Telegram chat to relay the failure to — copied from the originating dispatch request. Always present (the daemon only writes a notice when it has a chat to reply to). 0 is never a valid Telegram chat id; private chats are positive and group/supergroup/channel chats are negative, so the machine-checked contract is 'non-zero' rather than 'positive' (#258).

update_id.description: Telegram update id of the originating action, for correlation. Optional.

request_id.description: request_id of the dispatch request whose child failed.

exit_code.description: Non-zero exit status of the failed child.

command.description: The command string the daemon spawned (for surfacing the failing verb).
